websites.title: Websites
websites.description: One per line. A domain (stripe.com) or a full URL (https://www.notion.so/pricing).

deepScan.title: Deep scan (real browser)
deepScan.description: Open each site in headless Chrome and also detect tools that load with JavaScript (analytics, chat widgets, A/B testing, frameworks). Finds many more technologies; slower and priced higher. Off = fast scan of the page source.

includeDetails.title: Include details per technology
includeDetails.description: Adds version, confidence, categories, website and whether it's open source or SaaS for each technology.

checkDns.title: Check DNS and SSL
checkDns.description: Also look at public DNS records (email provider, DNS host, verification records) and the SSL issuer. Finds more technologies.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip sites whose robots.txt asks all bots to stay away. Skipped sites are free.

maxConcurrency.title: Websites checked at once
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to scan in parallel.
